item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00018","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C14","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 is a close drafting template for the child. Both are memoranda addressed to the same four officials; begin with a recommendation from the Director of the Foreign Operations Administration; determine that a capped dollar value of agricultural commodities from Commodity Credit Corporation stocks will be used for urgent foreign relief; define the amount by reference to the Corporation's investment and delivery-related costs; assign program operations and commodity specification to the Director; make transfers subject to terms and conditions determined by the Director after consultation with the Secretary of State; and require a bilateral agreement with the recipient government. The child adapts this machinery from Bolivia to flood relief in Austria and Germany and adds transportation details. C14 and C04 provide relevant institutional background but lack this distinctive package and sequence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"In accordance with the recommendation contained in the [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], submitted by the Director of the Foreign Operations Administration, and I hereby determine that up to $4,000,000 worth of agricultural commodities from the stocks of the Commodity Credit Corporation may be used","parent_excerpt":"In accordance with the recommendation contained in the [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE], submitted by the Director of the Foreign Operations Administration, and I hereby determine that up to $5,000,000 worth of agricultural commodities shall be made available out of the stocks of the Commodity Credit Corporation","explanation":"Nearly identical determination language, with only the amount, relief destination, and minor verbs adapted."},{"child_excerpt":"Arrangements for the operations of this relief program, including the specifications of the commodities ... shall be the responsibility of the Director of the Foreign Operations Administration and the transfer of the commodities shall be upon such terms and conditions as the Director determines to be appropriate, after consultation with the Secretary of State.","parent_excerpt":"Arrangements for the operations of this relief program, including the specification of the commodities, shall be the responsibility of the Director of the Foreign Operations Administration, and the transfer of the commodities shall be upon such terms and conditions as the Director determines to be appropriate, after consultation with the Secretary of State.","explanation":"This is essentially verbatim operative machinery assigning program administration, commodity specification, transfer conditions, and consultation responsibilities."},{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of State shall conclude any necessary bilateral agreements with the governments concerned in connection with the furnishing of this assistance.","parent_excerpt":"In connection with the furnishing of such assistance, the Secretary of State, after consultation with the Director, shall conclude ports.","explanation":"Both define the monetary ceiling through the Commodity Credit Corporation's investment plus domestic preparation and delivery costs, with the child giving a more detailed breakdown."}]}
